posts.title: Amazon, the new Blockbuster video rental store
posts.description: A recent television commercial that used the old song “Anything You Can Do (I Can Do Better)” got me interested in the origins of that tune. It’s from the 1950 movie musical “Annie Get Your Gun” – and before that a Broadway play. Being a fan of classic musicals, I looked into where I could stream it online.
